commands: set -eu; echo '=== GROWBOX LOG ==='; grep -E 'growbox-ml-controller|repository worker failed|repository turn deferred|config changed|control checkout missing|work checkout missing|scheduler cycle failed' "$HOME/Library/Logs/local-agent.log" | tail -n 160 || true; echo '=== LOCAL REPO STATUS ==='; cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories/growbox-ml-controller/status.json" 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== STATE DIR ==='; find "$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories/growbox-ml-controller" -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 80 || true; echo '=== CONTROL CHECKOUT ==='; git -C /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control status --short || true; git -C /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control rev-parse HEAD || true; git -C /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control rev-parse origin/agent-control || true; git -C /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control remote -v || true; echo '=== WORK CHECKOUT ==='; git -C /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/work status --short || true; git -C /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/work rev-parse HEAD || true
